summary: Extra variables come from surveys, the template and the API and can override inventory and project variables; prompted extra_vars are marked !unsafe (Jinja not expanded) unless set in the template, and launch API extra_vars only apply with an enabled survey or ask_variables_on_launch true. ALLOW_JINJA_IN_EXTRA_VARS controls Jinja.
questions: Why are my extra_vars ignored when launching through the API?
Why doesn't Jinja expand in prompted extra vars?
What does !unsafe mean for extra_vars in AAP?
How do I stop a survey overriding an inventory variable?

answer_card.title: Why launch-time extra_vars are ignored
answer_card.answer_md:
Extra variables sent to the job launch API are only used if **either**:

- they match variables in an **enabled survey**, or
- the template has `ask_variables_on_launch: true` (*Prompt on launch* for Variables).

Prompted extra vars are marked `!unsafe`, so Jinja in them is treated as a plain string; only variables saved in the template's own *Extra Variables* are trusted. See `ALLOW_JINJA_IN_EXTRA_VARS` to change this.
